description: Ground-truth calibration bands for the sim matrix. Matchup bands are real-world Modern priors (percent WR for deck_a); field bands are deck-level expected field WRs from the CLAUDE.md post-sim EXPECTED dict. Consumed by tools/check_calibration.py after every --matrix --save. Bands are data with provenance, not code constants.

matchup_bands.provenance: Calibration probe s60104 anchor (docs/diagnostics/2026-07-05_calibration_probe_findings.md): real Modern is near-even — control has sweepers + SB artifact hate; pre-fix sim said 90-95 for Affinity, the probe's founding divergence.
Calibration probe s60105 anchor: Amulet is the favorite in real Modern — big-mana ramp goes over the top of 1-for-1 midrange; Dimir's discard trades poorly vs land-based redundancy.
PR #445 validation anchor: Dimir's discard + counterspells + Bowmasters pressure make it a real but not crushing favorite over Storm in real Modern.
Real Modern prior: Boros carries efficient removal mainboard and 2-3 SB artifact-hate pieces; Bo3 with sideboarding makes Boros the favorite.
Real Modern prior: counter-heavy draw-go control is the classic storm predator; Storm's SB discard/Veil keeps it close.
Real Modern prior: aggro-midrange energy pressures control before sweeper mana; control stabilizes often enough to keep the band near even.
Real Modern prior: mirror-ish creature midrange where Boros's removal density and Phlage recursion give it a slight edge over Zoo.
Real Modern prior: E-Tron's Chalice/Karn package plus oversized bodies line up well vs Affinity's small-artifact swarm; SB hate widens it.
Real Modern prior: cascade board wipes punish Boros's go-wide plan; Boros SB graveyard hate keeps the band near even.
Real Modern prior: Dimir's discard + Orcish Bowmasters + graveyard interaction hurt reanimator combo; Goryo's is the underdog.
